WHY THE COVER MATTERS

More than a beautiful image.

01

First impression

A cover is often the first visual signal a reader receives. The design needs to establish tone quickly.

02

Audience fit

Typography, imagery, colour and composition can be shaped around the intended readership.

03

Commercial purpose

The goal is not decoration alone. The cover should help the book compete for attention in its market.

04

Clear communication

Genre, mood and story cues should work together rather than compete for attention.

HOW IT WORKS

A clear design process.

01

Project Brief

You share the book, audience, direction and requirements.

02

Direction

The visual route is defined before detailed design.

03

Design

The selected direction becomes a polished cover.

04

Refinement

Feedback is applied with attention to hierarchy and detail.

05

Delivery

Final files are prepared for the agreed formats.

ABOUT THE DESIGNER

Art with purpose.

I’m Valentine Oladele Melifue, founder of Digital Val Designs.

Growing up, I’ve always loved art. When I discovered graphic design, I found a way to combine that creative instinct with strategy—and that became the foundation of Digital Val Designs.

I don’t believe design should exist simply to fascinate people. Good design should serve a purpose. It should communicate, support a marketing goal, and create a first impression that is difficult for the right audience to ignore.

That’s why I’ve taken my learning beyond graphic design itself. I’ve invested in understanding the marketplace, audience psychology, and the commercial side of visual communication—so the designs I create aren’t just visually appealing, but commercially valuable.

I create with art. I design with purpose. I deliver for the market.

FAQ

Before we begin.

How long does a cover take?

Timing depends on project scope, feedback and required deliverables. A specific timeline is confirmed before work begins.

Can I request revisions?

Yes. The agreed project scope will define the included revision process.

Do you design ebook and print covers?

Yes. Ebook-only and print-ready options are available, including full wraps.

Can you prepare print-ready files?

Yes, when print production is part of the agreed deliverables.

Do you work with international authors?

Yes. The project process is structured to work remotely with authors and publishers.

What do you need from me?

The Project Brief collects the book title, author name, synopsis, genre, direction, references and production requirements.
